required_fields: expected_revisions (four keys; absent step_state revision uses null)

postreview_live_fields: capture_binding_ref to actual external Root full4 read after review

source_review_decision.review_author: actual independent peer, neither Root nor caller/builder Source author; backend Root delivery identity must agree

capture_binding.raw_rows: Exactly three LF-terminated original records: session_meta ordinal0 + actual call + matching returned output. Each selected line must match original fixed Root log at its exact integer offset. First/last ordinals and actual timestamps remain exact.
capture_binding.call: custom_tool_call/function_call; matching nonempty call_id; explicit exec/functions.exec or exec_command/functions.exec_command. Wrapper exec must request tools.exec_command and carry MAIN23_CAPTURE_OPERATION:<exact operation>. Unknown tool names are rejected.
capture_binding.returned_source: Decode one actual returned exec host dictionary with chunk_id, integer exit_code0, string output. Decode exactly one complete typed researchos.root-main23-capture-result.v2 from host output; arbitrary SHA strings never qualify.

operations.SOURCE_REVIEW_WITNESS: review HDF/MF/decision, plus actual peer delivery proof

capture_binding.Root_probe_requirement: Run a Root-owned finite public reader with locked Python through tools.exec_command; print the complete typed result JSON after checking all observed refs. Preserve this actual outer request/return, original source offsets and stdout; a standalone invented JSON or body containing hashes is rejected.

runtime_qualification.payload_rule: Every field except wrapper schema/payload_ref/root_issuance_binding_ref equals payload exactly; Root captures payload before wrapping the final qualification, avoiding a circular hash.
runtime_qualification.review_MF_rule: All members checked by exact path/SHA/bytes, including decision; HDF/MF/decision/source/caller pins match precisely.
runtime_qualification.time_order: scope.created <= review.reviewed <= actual peer receipt <= actual Root call <= actual Root output <= qualification.created
runtime_qualification.authority: Independent reviewer must supply actual closure evidence and backend formal delivery. Two Root JSONs claiming the same reviewer are insufficient. No qualification is created by this Source.
runtime_qualification.existing_runtime_gate: Locked Python/Go, loaded Python/native closure and actual module resources remain required; strict provenance is checked before native Job module loading. Same existing SourceReadGuard lifetime and child Job/cleanup rules remain.

activation_fields: capture_binding_ref to external Root read of facts+full4 after request
inverse: Pure transform verifies full before CP/OW inverse, original raw full4 archived; SS/CM held unchanged. TP callback does no file operations. SourceReadGuard excludes exclusive CP/OW before TP. Failed TP retains original partial journal; Root reconciliation only, no automatic inverse.
pending_policy: Root pending increment starts at current checkpoint.work_in_progress.root_next_failure_ordinal_live; contiguous unique invocation identities only. Existing counters stay byte-semantically unchanged. Missing process exit remains null, no retries/counter resets.
failure_policy: Persist exact builder returned state outside build root, including unpublished build.closed.json cases. If own persistence fails return entire record for external Root capture and persistence; Root assigns original ordinal. No self-synthesized external receipt or programme qualification.
public22: Actual product trial failed PUBLIC_RESTORE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH; separate end22 slice remains unaccepted

actual_peer_delivery.raw_rows: Original session_meta, inter_agent_communication_metadata and next backend response_item agent_message. Communication trigger_turn is bool, next ordinal and timestamps match, metadata.client_authored is false.
actual_peer_delivery.identity: Canonical actor codex:/root/<task> maps exactly to actual backend agent_message.author /root/<task> using removeprefix(codex:); typed delivery.review_author and binding.peer_actor remain canonical. Peer Rootthread, original message provenance, issuer, independent role exclusions and every pin are unchanged.
actual_peer_delivery.order: Actual peer delivery must precede Root observation/issuance. Root observes peer delivery; Root does not issue independent acceptance.
